display_long_description:
Solve mind-bending VR puzzles by teaming up with the worst person possible: **YOU**. 

Record physical **ACTIONS** and **VOICE** to build a team of past-copies. If the timeline fails, just shoot yourself!

Welcome to **UnLoop** – the most chaotic VR self-coop out there.
[media]
You need a highly coordinated squad to survive this space station. The catch? You are that squad. Every time the loop resets, your replica is left behind to repeat your exact physical movements, gestures, and voice in real-time. Yell instructions at your future-self, flip off your uncooperative past-self, and desperately try not to step on your own toes. 
[media]
Ever wanted to argue with a room full of people who all sound exactly like you? You’ve come to the right place. After a few loops, you will be surrounded by your own past-copies, all screaming the same expletives at each other. They all disagree with you. And worst of all... they are technically correct.

It’s chaotic, it’s loud, and yes – the voices in your head are entirely real.
[media]
Ruined the timeline? Didn’t catch a crucial item? No problem. Just raise your laser gun, shoot yourself, and instantly reset the loop. Or shoot your copy who made a bad throw, you are the original one anyway!

Death isn't a failure here. It's just a tactical undo button.
[media]
Solve puzzles by coordinating with your past actions. Sounds brilliant till you realize past-you was clueless too. Spend 15 minutes syncing three copies just to pass a keycard and you’ll feel like an absolute mastermind. You're welcome!
[media]
